decisions.reason: A reference class electrometer sits at the core of the firm's established dosimetry competence and is featured on the home page, so early results are likely near aspiration and there is no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.

The oncology risk management software is further from the firm's hardware core and its results are still uncertain, but it has its own page and complements the firm's radiotherapy quality-assurance portfolio, and the slack of an established instrument maker lets the firm carry it beyond its first year.
